findings.title: Dynamic fallback chain is not represented in the I18n translation cache key
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] builds the fallback order from SiteSetting.default_locale at lookup time. The translation cache in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb uses the key "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}" (line 72), which does not include the fallback chain or default locale. If an admin changes SiteSetting.default_locale, entries cached for a locale using the old fallback translation (for example fr falling back to es) will still be returned for fr until I18n.reload! or a restart. The cache key should include the fallback order/site default locale or the cache must be invalidated when default_locale changes.

findings.title: Fallback locales are only preloaded for web requests, not background jobs/mailers/rake tasks
findings.body: I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! is only called from ApplicationController#set_locale after setting the request locale. Other code paths call I18n.translate directly; translate_accelerator.rb's translate only load_locale(config.locale) and never ensures the fallback locales. With the new global FallbackLocaleList active in all environments, a missing key in a worker/mailer/rake task current locale will fall back to SiteSetting.default_locale or :en, but those locale files may not be loaded in that process, so the lookup can return a missing translation despite valid fallback translations. Preloading fallbacks should happen in the I18n.translate path or in ensure_loaded!, or background codepaths need the same preload.

findings.title: No specs cover the custom fallback order and preloading behavior
findings.body: This PR introduces a custom fallback chain, moves pluralization and fallback setup into a new initializer, and adds request-time ensure_loaded! preloading, but adds no tests. Regressions in fallback order (user locale, site default, English), the migration of pluralization, or loading fallback locales in non-controller contexts would not be caught. Add specs for FallbackLocaleList and for I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! plus fallback translation results outside ApplicationController.
